entries.name: Preacher Curl
entries.reason: Source-bound draft repair: side view exposes the supported elbow arc; fixed upper arms on a connected sloped pad,12-unit circular forearm path,1000ms peak and3000ms full return.253 neutral grip and setup are bound to the frozen repo import; independent exact-source technique and native runtime acceptance remain pending.
entries.summary: Curl with supported upper arms, then return slowly to the start.

frames.caption: Support the upper arms on the pad and hold the bar with palms facing up.
Curl through the elbows while the upper arms stay on the pad.
Bring the load toward the shoulders without lifting the elbows.
Hold the top with the shoulders and upper arms quiet.
Lower on a three-count to the same natural long-arm start.

entries.name: Preacher Hammer Dumbbell Curl
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, from the description accepted that day: the earlier drawing was a front view that could show neither the pad under the upper arms nor how far the arms straighten. Source-bound side-view draft: seated behind a sloping pad with the backs of both upper arms lying down its face; the upper arms do not leave the pad while the dumbbells are lowered slowly until the arms are almost straight, then curled back to shoulder height and held for a second. Each dumbbell stays square to its forearm, as a hammer is held.
entries.summary: Seated at a preacher bench with the upper arms on the pad and the palms facing each other, lower the dumbbells slowly until the arms are almost straight, curl them back to shoulder height and squeeze for a second.

frames.caption: Sit at a preacher bench and rest the backs of both upper arms on the pad, holding a dumbbell in each hand with the palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until the arms are almost straight and the biceps are stretched.
No bounce at the bottom.
Curl both back up to shoulder height with the palms still facing each other.
Squeeze for a second. Upper arms stay on the pad.

entries.name: Reverse Barbell Preacher Curls
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 28 degrees so the cambered EZ bar held in a shoulder-width palms-down grip, the preacher bench pad in painted contact beneath the stationary upper arms, the curl to shoulder height, the squeeze, and the slower lowering to extended arms all read clearly.
entries.summary: Resting the upper arms on a preacher bench pad with an EZ bar in a shoulder-width palms-down grip, curl the bar up to shoulder height while keeping the upper arms on the pad, squeeze, then lower slowly until the arms are extended.

frames.caption: Hold an EZ bar with a shoulder-width, palms-down grip and rest the upper arms on the preacher bench pad with the arms extended.
Keeping the upper arms on the pad, curl the bar up to shoulder height.
Squeeze at shoulder height with the palms facing down.
Lower slowly until the arms are extended.
Palms face down throughout and upper arms stay on the pad.
